mapper.select: SELECT chunk_id,ordinal,text,text_hash,start_byte,end_byte,preparation_schema,source_locator, source_json,source_digest,extraction_digest FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE tenant_id=#{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id=#{caller.userId} AND job_id=#{id} ORDER BY ordinal LIMIT 101

mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND document_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND job_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND document_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM knowledge_document WHERE lifecycle_ready = FALSE AND document_id > #{after} ORDER BY document_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document_revision (tenant_id, owner_id, document_id, content_revision, display_name, content_type, size_bytes, content_hash, source_bucket, source_key, first_job_id, created_at) VALUES (#{job.tenantId}, #{job.ownerId}, #{job.documentId}, #{job.documentVersion}, #{name}, #{job.contentType}, #{job.sizeBytes}, #{job.contentHash}, #{job.sourceBucket}, #{job.sourceKey}, #{job.jobId}, #{job.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET lifecycle_ready = TRUE, active_job_id = #{state.ingestionJobId}, published_generation = 1NULL, published_job_id = #{state.ingestionJobId}NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{state.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{state.ownerId} AND document_id = #{state.documentId} AND lifecycle_ready = FALSE AND version = 1 AND last_generation = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_ingestion (, command_scope, base_published_version, base_published_generation, base_published_job_id) VALUES (#{row.jobId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.ownerId}, #{row.documentId}, #{row.documentVersion}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.sourceBucket}, #{row.sourceKey}, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.contentType}, #{row.sizeBytes}, #{row.status}, #{row.stage}, #{row.errorCode}, #{row.retryable}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.revision}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt}, #{row.preparationSchema}, #{row.processorVersion}, #{row.parserProfile}, #{row.indexGeneration}, 'UPDATE', #{state.publishedVersion}, #{state.publishedGeneration}, #{state.publishedJobId})

INSERT INTO knowledge_lifecycle_command (command_id, tenant_id, owner_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, operation, document_id, accepted_revision, content_revision, index_generation, job_id, accepted_at) VALUES (#{input.commandId}, #{caller.tenantId}, #{caller.userId}, #{input.key}, #{input.fingerprint}, 'UPDATE', #{input.documentId}, #{input.expectedRevision} + 1, #{job.documentVersion}, #{job.indexGeneration}, #{job.jobId}, #{input.acceptedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.command_id, c.operation, c.document_id, c.accepted_revision, c.content_revision, c.index_generation, c.job_id, c.accepted_at, c.request_fingerprint FROM knowledge_lifecycle_command c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.owner_id = c.owner_id AND d.document_id = c.document_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND c.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND c.idempotency_key = #{key}
mapper.sql: SELECT d.document_id, d.revision, d.lifecycle, d.version AS latest_content_revision, d.published_version AS published_revision, d.published_generation, d.active_job_id, r.display_name, r.content_type, r.size_bytes, r.content_hash, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM knowledge_document d JOIN knowledge_document_revision r ON r.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND r.owner_id = d.owner_id AND r.document_id = d.document_id AND r.content_revision = d.version WHERE d.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND d.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND d.lifecycle_ready = TRUE AND d.lifecycle <> 'DELETED'
mapper.select: AND d.document_id > #{after} ORDER BY d.document_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_lifecycle_event (event_id, tenant_id, owner_id, document_id, command_id, job_id, actor, action, revision, lifecycle, created_at) SELECT #{eventId}, tenant_id, owner_id, document_id, #{commandId}, #{jobId}, #{actor}, #{action}, revision, lifecycle, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND document_id = #{id}
